notes: Starting cards as posted (marked '- Start'): Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe, Death Star, Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, First Strike, Secret Plans, Mobilization Points and Prepared Defenses; all counted in the deck. Three Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
The deck totals 61 cards as published (section counts 1+7+20+5+7+14+5+2); kept as posted.
Posted 'Set Your Course/Who Cares' dested Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe ('Who Cares' is the poster's joke for the back side).
Posted 'DIS' dested Dreaded Imperial Starfleet (the strategy: 'Cancel their drains with DIS'; it cancels Force drains by placing a non-unique starfighter from hand).

Posted 'Mob. Points' dested Mobilization Points (the strategy uses it to take Wakeelmui before activating); 'SFS' dested Sienar Fleet Systems; 'Empy's Sword' / 'Empy's Shield' dested The Emperor's Sword / The Emperor's Shield; 'Dreadnaught' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser.
Posted 'Vader w/ Saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Commander Brendei' dested Commander Brandei.
Secret Plans is the 2001 Special Edition Effect (not the later Defensive Shield).
Posted Sullust, Endor and Kessel dested the Dark Side system cards.
